versions.subject: Merge PR #4961 from @tsale - Add multiples rules and updates
versions.detection:
selection_main:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\cmd.exe'
    Image|endswith:
        - '\cool.exe'
        - '\zero.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'Administrator'
        - '-c'
selection_payloads_1:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'taskkill'
        - '/f'
        - '/im'
selection_payloads_2:
    CommandLine|contains: 'powershell'
condition: selection_main and 1 of selection_payloads_*
versions.spl: ParentImage="*\\cmd.exe" Image IN ("*\\cool.exe", "*\\zero.exe") CommandLine="*Administrator*" CommandLine="*-c*" (CommandLine="*taskkill*" CommandLine="*/f*" CommandLine="*/im*") OR CommandLine="*powershell*"
